notes.content:
🎁 TIME-LIMITED BUNDLE DEALS
We're incredibly excited to bring you the first major milestone of Inkborn - now available in Early Access on Steam! To celebrate the launch, Inkborn is currently bundled for a limited time with other great games from Acram Franchise - you get an extra 17% off, summing up to 25% total discount for the game with Charterstone:

✒️ Experience the full tactical core of the game, with the addition of Act 2, you'll face new enemies, unlock more cards, and dive even deeper into the evolving challenge that awaits:

🃏 Craft your deck from over 60 hand-designed cards, each built with synergy in mind.
🧠 Discover the brand new tactical layer where card order truly matters. Unleash 25 Glyph-based combos, each more surprising and synergistic than the last. Make meaningful decisions and discover multiple new ways to play your hand and refine a deck.
⚔️ Challenge 19 unique opponents, each with their own fighting mechanics, strategies, and surprises.

notes.title: Charterstone: Digital Edition is a part of Turn-Based Carnival 2024! 🎲
notes.content:
Charterstone: Digital Edition is joining another exciting edition of the Turn-Based Carnival!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the Turn-Based Carnival, we are proud to announce our first original game - Inkborn, a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on Early Access in Q2 2025! 🖋️

What sets Inkborn apart? 🃏
Inkborn features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original Origami art style and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with over 100 kinds of cards, and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the Full Release in Q2 2026. 🎮

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of intricate folds and strategic choices. Add Inkborn to your wishlist and follow to stay in the loop! 👇

notes.title: Add K2: Digital Edition To Your Wishlist!
notes.content:
We would like to proudly announce that we've become the official publishers of an exciting upcoming digital board game adaptation developed by our friends at Devon Games! 🤝

K2: Digital Edition brings the thrill of climbing K2 - Earth’s second-highest and one of the most dangerous mountains - right to your screen. Compete against AI with 3 difficulty levels, challenge your friends in real-time or asynchronous multiplayer, test your skills in a fast-paced single-player campaign or face the journey alone. 🧭 The game is easy to learn but hard to survive, offering a gripping and fun experience. Check the weather forecast regularly to adjust for freezing and severe conditions, and aim for the right weather window to set up your camp. 🏔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/f88c6ce9fa31813e6f49935dea895fbae8e32ee2.png

Plus, the public demo is live on Steam - so you can get a taste of the challenge every day! Don’t miss out on the adventure - add it to your wishlist and be among the first to conquer K2’s deadly summit! 🥳

As of now you can access Salt and Forum modules, and Hispania and Byzantium maps on iOS, Android, Steam, and GOG!

Salt is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png

Forum is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png

Hispania & Byzantium are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png

Last call for the tournament!

Don't forget you can still sign up for the Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament!
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely free of charge and there are real prizes to be won provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 is live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/4e79af573f62b354b69a16d747f26b4b6cb51905.jpg

The patches are getting fewer and farther in between. That's good - this means there's less things that require fixing!

The patch is live on Steam, App Store and Play Store as we speak. 

Here's the full list of changes for this patch: 

[Added] A proper screen resolution options window.
[Change] Building card that can be constructed automatically will be highlighted when we perform certain actions (that give that result).
[Change] The default charter name is now "{Player Name}'s Charter".
[Change] Popup input field no longer opens up automatically on mobile devices - this allows users to read the actual popup.
[Fix] The icon of Retrieve All action from Coach Persona (313) no longer appears on buildings - it caused confusion.
[Fix] Fixed the tooltips given by the bottom-right corner characters.
[Fix] When and if players auto-unlock components in Game 11 - it happens via a Chest opening animation. For clarity.
[Fix] Building points value will now always be visible during construction.
[Fix] Fixed the Game 4 Guidepost (it will now properly inform about the current game being longer or shorter than usual).
[Fix] Icons vanishing under the Buildings on big screens.
[Fix] We can now send Butler to an Objective Scoring Building if we need one more Coin to score the "Have 6 Coins" objective.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where a Player was falsely accused of blowing out the Candle (when another player took the Fuel Shortage peril token).
[Fix] Fixed game freezing when using Amulets while having no Influence.
[Fix] Fixed reconnecting to online games.
[Fix] Income from buildings was appearing without Charter symbol. Now fixed.
[Fix] Perfumer Persona (257) no longer lets us retrieving the worker we just sent.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.1.0 - Teach Me Your Ways!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/888220ad7b81d7d9d48ccf74161b47cdf339216c.jpg


You know an update is big when it's all golden and all! This time we bring you the long - awaited update o the tutorial! Jumping into the campaign should now be easier and more seamless to players unfamiliar with Charterstone. 

Full list of changes: 


 [Change] Tutorial has been updated! Having received a multitude of comments, emails, messages, and tweets telling us our tutorial was not good enough - we've updated it! We hope this will make the entry-level for players completely new to Charterstone lower and enhance everyone's overall experience. Give it a try and let us know if you think it's still missing something.
 [Fix] Building values have returned (oops!).
 [Fix] 3 digit values will now be taken into account in the window where we choose the Campaign scoring type.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where the Candle sabotage action appeared twice in a row.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where the game would not automatically pick and play the Treasure card that would skip the building's cost, where it was the only card the player could have chosen because they could not afford the building's cost.
 [Change] We added the option to take a scroll from the advancement mat and to play it immediately to skip a building's cost (even if we can afford it normally).
 [Change] Entering a room will now make all lingering notifications (red badge in the News section) be considered as read - the game will assume you've seen the - and thus the badge will disappear.
 [Fix] If you rename a Card, you no longer have to press Enter to confirm the change.
 [Fix] You can no longer spy on your opponent's choices during Sky Islands by viewing tooltips that should not yet have been there.
 [Fix] Architect Persona granting VP and Coins when we receive a Building Card will now properly activate if we get a card from a Crate.
 [Fix] Technomage Persona will now properly force the discard from the players with all minions on the board.
 [Fix] You can now log in using an email address that contains a "+" sign.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.9 - Fun and Interactive
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/3d58c12ed75f8a754195f3b3d6a6770d567e4941.jpg

List of things:

 [Fix] Fixed the Loyal/Rebel plaques.
 [Fix] You can't now visit a building with an Influence cost with your Robot while using a Scroll.
 [Fix] Merchant bonus will now be displayed correctly.
 [Change] Added a used personas tooltip to the Personas screen.
 [Fix] Fixed the online "can't confirm capacity/glory" error.
 [Fix] Fixed the situation where: 1. we couldn't afford a building's cost, 2. Used a scroll to skip a building's cost, 3. We're still missing a building card or a crate that is required, and the game would let us visit the building anyway.
 [Fix] Fixed the error where Friend would grant us a bonus when we discarded Coins.
 [Fix] We can now visit an Objective scoring building with a robot if it'll allow us to score an objective.
 [Fix] Alchemist persona interactions have been fixed.
 [Change] Card numbers have returned.
 [Change] We will now show the buildings' point values during their construction or when placing the Sky Islands.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.8 - Objectively Better
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/3c0da0b32249a6eff346502c961047a23ed513ca.jpg

This time we cleaned up some timeline related issues, UI relics, tooltips, etc. as well as fixed some odd bugs related to the objectives. 


 [Change] Timeline during the end-of-game phase will now only show one player choosing resources - and mark that player with their icon.
 [Fix] Fixed the bug where we couldn't make a move during the Sky Islands selection.
 [Change] Added multiple simple tooltips with the name of the particular building or space.
 [Change] We hid the Cards numbers - they were a relic from the board game anyway.
 [Fix]You can now send a Worker to a building requiring Influence if you have a Persona that will give you an influence (and you don't have one at that point).
 [Fix] Candlemaker will now be shown properly in the Sky Islands window.
 [Fix] Fixes to the scoring of the Spread Your Influence Objective.
 [Fix] Playing Item cards in certain moments could cause us to no longer be able to afford a building's cost. This will no longer happen.
 [Fix] You can revert the game state to the beginning (again).
 [Fix] Fixed the "buildings in the Charter" window - the one that showed the ones on the board, on the Sky Islands, and in the supply.
 [Fix] When we have the persona that allows us to pick a card from the mat or reveal cards from the deck, and there are no cards on the advancement mat - the picking from the advancement mat stage will be skipped automatically.
 [Fix] You will no longer be able to skip the permanent loss of Influence.
 [Fix] Objective 218 (Build Your Reputation) will now recognize we can gain Reputation with a Specter or a Ghost.
 [Fix] Objective 228 (Teambuilder) will now recognize the minion you may send to the Objective scoring building.
 [Fix] Sometimes after Game 11 some Crates would no longer contain cards - which has been fixed.
 [Fix] End of Campaign window would not display for some players - now it will.
 [Fix] Fixed the corner case with a Scroll to skip a building's cost and an Alchemist persona interaction (where Scroll wouldn't work).
 [Change] Added Rebel/Loyalist markings to rebel and loyalist Personas.
 [Fix] The Title of the Specter tooltip is now properly translated.
 [Fix] Glory points in the Scoring window are now displayed properly (multiplied by 10).
 [Fix] Fixed the error with displaying bonus in tooltips multiple times.
 [Fix] Bonus benefits in the Income buildings are now greyed out correctly (when applicable).
 [Fix] Fixed the issue with Workers not returning to their default position after using an Amulet.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.7 - Costs and Benefits
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/35bcc431b30622f9e43f3d5fbfe2ad0c4996a32e.jpg

In contrast to the previous updates - this one is live on iOS, Steam and Android already. #Yay


 [Fix] The cost of the building is now properly taken into account when checking if a player can score an Objective.
 [Fix] End of Campaign scoring will now properly refresh in the window in which we chose it. 
 [Fix] Fixed localization of the Candle window.
 [Fix] Fixed the game 11  not-being-able-to-select-a-Minion bug. 
 [Fix] Game will now properly recognize Butler and money Friend interaction when determining if we can afford a bulding's Cost. 
 [Fix] Will no longer freeze when using the Treasure to skip building's Cost.
 [Fix] Now proper text will be displayed when you try to build over an already visited Income building.
 [Fix] The game will automatically skip Futurist's ability if there are no cards on the mat and in the deck. 
 [Fix] Personas window will now display two-digit number of personas used (as opposed to one-digit so far). 
 [Fix] Game will no longer insist we chose Metal as a Golem bonus.
 [Change] Added a badge to the Objectives Mat button that will notify us when we can score an objective.
 [Change] Added a badge to the Advancement Mat and Personas window that will notify us if we receive new cards. 
 [Fix] Fixed the Game 6 bug wherethe game froze after receiving points for the die roll more than once during our turn.
 [Fix] Fixed the bug where game would freeze between campaign games (during the transition). 
 [Fix] Game will no longer allow us to send a robot to the Objective scoring building, when there is a Scroll on the Advancement Mat, since we couldn't use it to score an objective anyway. Assuming we had no Objective to score, of course. 
 [Fix] Game will now allow us to send a Golem to an objective requiring Coins (when we don't have any) and we do have an Alchemist persona. 
 [Fix] Scoring points at the end of the Campaign will now start with the player who made the Guidepost decision - as it should.
 [Fix] Merchant persona will now properly generate a die roll even if we go to the Charted selected by a previous die roll.
 [Fix] Fixes to deciding what ending we receive - taking into account inactive Charters. 
 [Fix] Localization fixes to the Guidepost and Final Battle windows. 
 [Change] Windows where we select resources will now display counters - i.e. Any Resource 1/3. 
 [Change] Added animations of constructing buildings in inactive Charters. 
 [Change] Enhanced the visual indication (vignete) of replay taking place.
 [Fix] Constructor building now works again. 
 [Fix] Fixes to deciding whether the player can go to an Objective scoring building.
 [Fix] Fixes to deciding whether the player can go to a building with an Influence cost while having a Chef.
 [Fix] You can now play Treasures during your small turn (making decision during another player's turn) and not lose it's bonus.
 [Change] The Cost and the Benefit of buildings will now be displayed in the same way in the buildings' index and on the board.
 [Fix] Fixed the occasional game crash during Income phase.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Catch 22
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/67c465aed0cc94c919c85d6db258bef691c6f33b.jpg

This time we mostly dealt with weird edge cases that freeze the game because it actually works properly and we did not put safety measures against some Catch 22-like cases. This will not happen now, but they ones that already have will remain like this - so restarting that given game may be required.

Anyway, here's a nice bullet pointed list. 

 [Fix] You will no longer be misled you can score your opponents' objective.
 [Fix] You will no longer be able to send a Worker (Golem to be exact) to an objective scoring building when you could not score any objectives.
 [Fix] Fixes to the campaign scoring choice moment in the Campaign.
 [Fix] Game 6 will no longer get blocked after the die roll.
 [Fix] Timeline fixes to the Glory choices at the beginning of games.
 [Fix][AI] Small errors fixed.
 [Fix] Wins after games 2 and 3 will now be counted correctly.
 [Fix] Scroll would sometimes skip the actual construction of a building, not just the cost of said construction. Now fixed.
 [Fix] Fixed the background operations where the scroll should play itself automatically.,
 [Fix] Game will now properly detect situations where there is no room for constructing a building and thus forbid you from visiting a construction building.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.5.2 - Disco Italiano
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/d2b1a866ab179321e84f06acd5d99082f115e9a5.jpg

Long story short - we fixed a whole bunch of pesky bugs, optimized the game a bit and added the Italian translation. 

The update is live on iOS and Steam, and will be live on Android... when Google says so. 


 [Fix] Crate opening replay animation was fixed.
 [Fix] Bonus for the die roll in game 6 now works properly.
 [Fix] Friends now combo properly with the bonus for the game 6 die roll.
 [Fix] Gambler Persona no longer works in Commons and Cloud Port.
 [Fix] Multiple fixes to the buildings' tooltips - they're now more accurate and more precise.
 [Fix] The voice queue announcing the last round will no longer repeat when it shouldn't.
 [Camera] Moving the camera during the between-rounds replay will take over the control over the camera. It will no longer reset with each player's turn. Looking around the map during other players' turns should be way less frustrating now.
 [Tutorial] We changed around some of the tutorial screens in the Commons section.
 [Fix] Titles of Glory categories now properly change with their descriptions.
 [Fix] Replay button works again.
 [Fix] Replay now works in the beginning stages of the Campaign - including the opening story screens.
 [Fix] Certain multiplayer rooms broke during replay - this will no longer happen.
 [Android][iOS] The game consumes less RAM now.
 [Fix] Fixed the bug where we could not rename cards if we opened the cards screen for the first time.
 [Fix] Games frozen at the end-of-game 8 will now unfreeze.
 [Fix] The game will no longer get stuck when crafting an Item after sending a Worker to a Building (and no longer being able to afford the building).
 [Tutorial] The tutorial will now appear at the beginning of our turn, not when placing the first building and it's been added to the multiplayer now as well.
 [Tutorial] Additional tutorial improvements - appropriate elements of the UI are now being highlighted when tutorialized.
 [Fix] The Online Game will no longer freeze if the player leaves it during placing of the first building.
 [Fix] Progress Track now properly shows the amount of steps for the game.
 [AI] AI will try to send its Minions before its workers now.
 [Added] Italian translation.

notes.title: Updade 1.0.4.0 - Long Live the Multiplayer
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/f4d46a538928659c73ff2a42ace8951ed5276dda.jpg

tl;dr Most, if not all issues with online games freezing, crashing or otherwise breaking should be fixed. 


[AI] AI Easy should now be easier to beat. 
[AI] AI will not open Crates with a lot of buildings in them at the end of games so that they don't lose those buildings.
[FIX] You can now load the local Campaigns that got broken and were stuck in the loading screen.
[FIX] Online Campaign error "Invalid saved game data. Error Code: -2" has been fixed. If you encounter it again, please contact us immediately.
[FIX] Advancement of Progress Token (and all connected triggers - like Sherpa) at the last step of the Progress Track will no longer happen. Last step is the last step, as it should be.
[FIX] Missing text from end-of-game 11 was fixed.
[FIX] Guideposts should all work properly now.
[FIX] Constructing a building is now a revertable action.
[FIX] Cards, resources and components that should be unlocked automatically at a certain stage now properly do so. 
[FIX] Using a Crafter persona could have, in certain cases, grant us too many VP. It's been fixed.
[FIX] Text in the amount of Coins to gain choise window has been fixed.
[FIX] In some cases the game would allow us to send our Robot to a building we could not afford. The game would not allow us to revert that move due to revealing a card from the Advancement Deck - effectively freezing the game. This will no longer happen.
[FIX] You will no longer freeze the game by clicking the wrong way in the Sky Islands window.
[FIX] Game would sometimes not allow us take the Advancement Card via a Robot if we had the Persona card 255.
[FIX] Glory assigning issue has been fixed.
[FIX] Perills now correctly appear on buildings constructed automatically in inactive Charters. 
[FIX] Objective Card 310 (Have at Least 3 Minions) now shows how many Minions we have and how many we're still missing.
[FIX] Online Games will no longer freeze during companion bonus selection.


Do bare in mind that whilst the update is live on Steam and iOS we can only guess (and hope) when will it be live on Google. So keep that in mind when playing online.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.3.0 - Getting Warmer
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/5ae506146581e4828dcba85babe2903c6c81d358.jpg

Here's the comprehensive list of things we un-broke or otherwise meddled with:
 [Fix] Game will no longer freeze during chosing a resource to gain after our minion was bumped.
 [Fix]  Game no longer freezes when we pick an Objective card, have an Ambassador Persona active and the Objectives pile is empty.
 [Fix] Fixes to reverting your action in the end-of-game phase and adjustments to timeline during that phase.
 [Fix] Game 6 dice roll bonus will not be aplied every time anymore.
 [Fix] We will no longer freeze the game during AI turn (or turn replay) by opening random screens. Browse away!
 [Fix] Personas that grant bonus for using buildings with a particular cost now properly also work on Income buildings.
 [Fix] Personas awarding points for a particular type of resource (i.e. cards) at the end of the game now work properly.
 [Fix] Merchant will not grant points twice anymore.
 [Fix] Fixed a bug where we couldn't re-use once-per-game Personas later in the Campaign.
 [Fix] In certain situations guidepost for the Game 6 could have been resolved improperly - which has now been fixed.
 [Fix][Online] This actually happened in the meantime - server code was adjusted and many rooms that were broken are now fixed.
 [AI] AI-Hard has a new playstyle now - it will focus more heavily on construction early in the campaign. (AI picks one of several implemented playstyles at random at the beginning of a game)


One thing we DID NOT fix is the Glory assigning issue. We're still tracking that one down. What we can tell you is that it seems to be a synchronous online issue only - so a temporary workaround is that you switch to asynchronous just before the end-of-game phase. And you do that by only having one person in the room at a time.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.0 - Fancy Coursor
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/ab3b049273d65987d076e45a9b8a9e3659c0aa4d.jpg

More fixes: 


 [Fix] Ambassador Persona now works as intended. 
 [Fix] Once-per-game Personas now properly work once per game, not all the time. This will only work in newly started games.
 [Fix] Online Play Sky Island placement no longer freezes the game. It actually never did, but it did look like it. 
 [Fix] Private Objectives are now displayed properly. 
 [Fix] Game will no longer get locked during card selection when there are no cards on the Mat or in the Draw Pile.
 [Fix] Multiplayer games should no longer freeze during the Capacity/Glory end-of-game stages.
 [Fix] Fixed the issue where a player could get blocked when picking a card from Robot on a building the cost of which the player could not afford (but was allowed to go there thanks to a Treasure ignoring the building's cost). 
 [Fix] (we believe that) the cases where a single building was the wrong size or shifted in an odd direction should have been eliminated. Hopefully. 
 [Fix] Online games will no longer claim it's your turn when it isn't. 
 [AI] Numerous tweaks to AI. Should be a bit more clever.
 [Additionally] No more default system coursor! We added a new fancy one. 


And as last time, let us know whenever you find anything out of the ordinary.

notes.title: Charterstone: Digital Edition - 12% release discount!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/0c10028b2c080239e20ed201440f57a81feefb46.jpg

The official digital adaptation of Jamey Stegmaier’s board game - Charterstone 

A campaign strategy game with high replayability, where players build the new Eternal City!

Build and Discover in Charterstone!

Just take a look at the honors the board game received:
🏆 2018 Diana Jones Award for Excellence in Gaming Nominee
🏆 2017 Meeples' Choice Nominee
🏆 2017 Golden Geek Most Innovative Board Game Nominee

The campaign is divided into a series of separate games. Each game will have its own unique rule and bonus objective. Each game will build upon the previous one and add something new! Your decisions and play style will affect the progress and the end of the campaign. What’s more, there are no negative interactions between players. In other words, you score points on the back of your own strategy, not by undermining your opponents. It’s especially important when playing against your friends or family in online or hot-seats multiplayer!

So what is the game about?

Can you convince the forever king to declare your village the new Eternal City?
✔️ Pick one of the 6 unique characters to lead your charter
✔️ Discover new buildings, scoring possibilities and game mechanics
✔️ Strategize and manage your workers, buildings and resources
✔️ Watch the ruleset, and the village, expand from game to game
✔️ Build upon your progress from previous games
✔️ Uncover the story as you progress through the campaign

What can you expect?
• Official Charterstone rules, consulted with Jamey Stegmaier himself
• Play with AI, friends or both - great experience for both solo and group play
• Online cross-platform multiplayer
• Hot-seats style local multiplayer
• AI opponents - Easy, Medium or Hard
• Full 12 games Campaign
• Single Game mode - a flexible and adjustable mode for a quick match!
• Save your map at any time and play it later with your friends
• Pre-set and randomly generated maps
• Awesomely animated board game map, buildings, cards, characters and more!
• Full replayability - no two campaigns will be the same
• Beautiful art by Mr. Cuddington and Gong Studios
• Unique experience of a board game with the convenience of a digital platform
